record.bible_text: And it came to pass in the twelfth<WH08147><WH06240> year<WH08141>, in the twelfth month<WH02320>, in the first<WH0259> <FI>day<Fi> of the month<WH02320>, <FI>that<Fi> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, take up<WH05375><WTH8798> a lamentation<WH07015> for Pharaoh<WH06547> king<WH04428> of Egypt<WH04714>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto him, Thou art like<WH01819><WTH8738> a young lion<WH03715> of the nations<WH01471>, and thou <FI>art<Fi> as a whale<WH08577><WTH8676><WH08565> in the seas<WH03220>: and thou camest forth<WH01518><WTH8799> with thy rivers<WH05104>, and troubledst<WH01804><WTH8799> the waters<WH04325> with thy feet<WH07272>, and fouledst<WH07515><WTH8799> their rivers<WH05104>. <RF>whale: or, dragon<Rf>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; I will therefore spread out<WH06566><WTH8804> my net<WH07568> over thee with a company<WH06951> of many<WH07227> people<WH05971>; and they shall bring thee up<WH05927><WTH8689> in my net<WH02764>.

Then will I leave<WH05203><WTH8804> thee upon the land<WH0776>, I will cast thee forth<WH02904><WTH8686> upon the open<WH06440> field<WH07704>, and will cause all the fowls<WH05775> of the heaven<WH08064> to remain<WH07931><WTH8689> upon thee, and I will fill<WH07646><WTH8689> the beasts<WH02416> of the whole earth<WH0776> with thee.
And I will lay<WH05414><WTH8804> thy flesh<WH01320> upon the mountains<WH02022>, and fill<WH04390><WTH8765> the valleys<WH01516> with thy height<WH07419>.

I will also water<WH08248><WTH8689> with thy blood<WH01818> the land<WH0776> wherein thou swimmest<WH06824>, <FI>even<Fi> to the mountains<WH02022>; and the rivers<WH0650> shall be full<WH04390><WTH8735> of thee. <RF>the land wherein...: or, the land of thy swimming<Rf>

And when I shall put thee out<WH03518><WTH8763>, I will cover<WH03680><WTH8765> the heaven<WH08064>, and make<WH06937><WH00> the stars<WH03556> thereof dark<WH06937><WTH8689>; I will cover<WH03680><WTH8762> the sun<WH08121> with a cloud<WH06051>, and the moon<WH03394> shall not give<WH0215><WTH8686> her light<WH0216>. <RF>put...: or, extinguish thee<Rf>

All the bright<WH03974> lights<WH0216> of heaven<WH08064> will I make dark<WH06937><WTH8686> over thee, and set<WH05414><WTH8804> darkness<WH02822> upon thy land<WH0776>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>. <RF>bright...: Heb. lights of the light in heaven<Rf> <RF>dark: Heb. them dark<Rf>

I will also vex<WH03707><WTH8689> the hearts<WH03820> of many<WH07227> people<WH05971>, when I shall bring<WH0935><WTH8687> thy destruction<WH07667> among the nations<WH01471>, into the countries<WH0776> which thou hast not known<WH03045><WTH8804>. <RF>vex: Heb. provoke to anger, or, grief<Rf>

Yea, I will make many<WH07227> people<WH05971> amazed<WH08074><WTH8689> at thee, and their kings<WH04428> shall be horribly<WH08178> afraid<WH08175><WTH8799> for thee, when I shall brandish<WH05774><WTH8788> my sword<WH02719> before them<WH06440>; and they shall tremble<WH02729><WTH8804> at <FI>every<Fi> moment<WH07281>, every man<WH0376> for his own life<WH05315>, in the day<WH03117> of thy fall<WH04658>.
For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; The sword<WH02719> of the king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon thee.

By the swords<WH02719> of the mighty<WH01368> will I cause thy multitude<WH01995> to fall<WH05307><WTH8686>, the terrible<WH06184> of the nations<WH01471>, all of them: and they shall spoil<WH07703><WTH8804> the pomp<WH01347> of Egypt<WH04714>, and all the multitude<WH01995> thereof shall be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8738>.

I will destroy<WH06><WTH8689> also all the beasts<WH0929> thereof from<WH05921> beside the great<WH07227> waters<WH04325>; neither shall the foot<WH07272> of man<WH0120> trouble<WH01804><WTH8799> them any more, nor the hoofs<WH06541> of beasts<WH0929> trouble<WH01804><WTH8799> them.
Then will I make their waters<WH04325> deep<WH08257><WTH8686>, and cause their rivers<WH05104> to run<WH03212><WTH8686> like oil<WH08081>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

When I shall make<WH05414><WTH8800> the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> desolate<WH08077>, and the country<WH0776> shall be destitute<WH08074><WTH8737> of that whereof it was full<WH04393>, when I shall smite<WH05221><WTH8687> all them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein, then shall they know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>destitute...: Heb. desolate from the fulness thereof<Rf>

This <FI>is<Fi> the lamentation<WH07015> wherewith they shall lament<WH06969><WTH8790> her: the daughters<WH01323> of the nations<WH01471> shall lament<WH06969><WTH8787> her: they shall lament<WH06969><WTH8787> for her, <FI>even<Fi> for Egypt<WH04714>, and for all her multitude<WH01995>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>

It came to pass also in the twelfth<WH08147><WH06240> year<WH08141>, in the fifteenth<WH02568><WH06240> <FI>day<Fi> of the month<WH02320>, <FI>that<Fi> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, wail<WH05091><WTH8798> for the multitude<WH01995> of Egypt<WH04714>, and cast them down<WH03381><WTH8685>, <FI>even<Fi> her, and the daughters<WH01323> of the famous<WH0117> nations<WH01471>, unto the nether parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>, with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> into the pit<WH0953>.
Whom dost thou pass in beauty<WH05276><WTH8804>? go down<WH03381><WTH8798>, and be thou laid<WH07901><WTH8713> with the uncircumcised<WH06189>.

They shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> in the midst<WH08432> of <FI>them that are<Fi> slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>: she is delivered<WH05414><WTH8738> to the sword<WH02719>: draw<WH04900><WTH8798> her and all her multitudes<WH01995>. <RF>she...: or, the sword is laid<Rf>

The strong<WH0410> among the mighty<WH01368> shall speak<WH01696><WTH8762> to him out of the midst<WH08432> of hell<WH07585> with them that help<WH05826><WTH8802> him: they are gone down<WH03381><WTH8804>, they lie<WH07901><WTH8804> uncircumcised<WH06189>, slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>.
Asshur<WH0804> <FI>is<Fi> there and all her company<WH06951>: his graves<WH06913> <FI>are<Fi> about<WH05439> him: all of them slain<WH02491>, fallen<WH05307><WTH8802> by the sword<WH02719>:

Whose graves<WH06913> are set<WH05414><WTH8738> in the sides<WH03411> of the pit<WH0953>, and her company<WH06951> is round about<WH05439> her grave<WH06900>: all of them slain<WH02491>, fallen<WH05307><WTH8802> by the sword<WH02719>, which caused<WH05414><WTH8804> terror<WH02851> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>. <RF>terror: or, dismaying<Rf>

There <FI>is<Fi> Elam<WH05867> and all her multitude<WH01995> round about<WH05439> her grave<WH06900>, all of them slain<WH02491>, fallen<WH05307><WTH8802> by the sword<WH02719>, which are gone down<WH03381><WTH8804> uncircumcised<WH06189> into the nether parts<WH08482> of the earth<WH0776>, which caused<WH05414><WTH8804> their terror<WH02851> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>; yet have they borne<WH05375><WTH8799> their shame<WH03639> with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>.

They have set<WH05414><WTH8804> her a bed<WH04904> in the midst<WH08432> of the slain<WH02491> with all her multitude<WH01995>: her graves<WH06913> <FI>are<Fi> round about<WH05439> him: all of them uncircumcised<WH06189>, slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>: though their terror<WH02851> was caused<WH05414><WTH8737> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>, yet have they borne<WH05375><WTH8799> their shame<WH03639> with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>: he is put<WH05414><WTH8738> in the midst<WH08432> of <FI>them that be<Fi> slain<WH02491>.

There <FI>is<Fi> Meshech<WH04902>, Tubal<WH08422>, and all her multitude<WH01995>: her graves<WH06913> <FI>are<Fi> round about<WH05439> him: all of them uncircumcised<WH06189>, slain<WH02490><WTH8794> by the sword<WH02719>, though they caused<WH05414><WTH8804> their terror<WH02851> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>.

And they shall not lie<WH07901><WTH8799> with the mighty<WH01368> <FI>that are<Fi> fallen<WH05307><WTH8802> of the uncircumcised<WH06189>, which are gone down<WH03381><WTH8804> to hell<WH07585> with their weapons<WH03627> of war<WH04421>: and they have laid<WH05414><WTH8799> their swords<WH02719> under their heads<WH07218>, but their iniquities<WH05771> shall be upon their bones<WH06106>, though <FI>they were<Fi> the terror<WH02851> of the mighty<WH01368> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>. <RF>with their...: Heb. with weapons of their war<Rf>
Yea, thou shalt be broken<WH07665><WTH8735> in the midst<WH08432> of the uncircumcised<WH06189>, and shalt lie<WH07901><WTH8799> with <FI>them that are<Fi> slain<WH02491> with the sword<WH02719>.

There <FI>is<Fi> Edom<WH0123>, her kings<WH04428>, and all her princes<WH05387>, which with their might<WH01369> are laid<WH05414><WTH8738> by <FI>them that were<Fi> slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>: they shall lie<WH07901><WTH8799> with the uncircumcised<WH06189>, and with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>. <RF>laid: Heb. given, or, put<Rf>

There <FI>be<Fi> the princes<WH05257> of the north<WH06828>, all of them, and all the Zidonians<WH06722>, which are gone down<WH03381><WTH8804> with the slain<WH02491>; with their terror<WH02851> they are ashamed<WH0954><WTH8802> of their might<WH01369>; and they lie<WH07901><WTH8799> uncircumcised<WH06189> with <FI>them that be<Fi> slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>, and bear<WH05375><WTH8799> their shame<WH03639> with them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> to the pit<WH0953>.

Pharaoh<WH06547> shall see<WH07200><WTH8799> them, and shall be comforted<WH05162><WTH8738> over all his multitude<WH01995>, <FI>even<Fi> Pharaoh<WH06547> and all his army<WH02428> slain<WH02491> by the sword<WH02719>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

For I have caused<WH05414><WTH8804> my terror<WH02851> in the land<WH0776> of the living<WH02416>: and he shall be laid<WH07901><WTH8717> in the midst<WH08432> of the uncircumcised<WH06189> with <FI>them that are<Fi> slain<WH02491> with the sword<WH02719>, <FI>even<Fi> Pharaoh<WH06547> and all his multitude<WH01995>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
